title: CCIP Messenger
summary: Messages between Avalanche and other EVMs
description: A messenger on the C-Chain and on an Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base or OP testnet, talking over Chainlink CCIP 2.0. Senders allowlist destinations, receivers allowlist the counterpart in both _ccipReceive and getCCVsAndFinalityConfig.
prompts: Send a message from Avalanche to a contract on Ethereum
Trigger a contract on Base from the C-Chain
Cross-chain messaging between Avalanche and other EVM chains

destination.description: Other EVM chain; deploying there is signed by the builder's wallet

params.name: receiverGasLimit
params.description: Gas for _ccipReceive on the destination; storing a 280-byte message first costs about 150,000

prerequisites: Fuji AVAX for gas and CCIP fees
Testnet ETH on the destination chain in the builder's wallet, to deploy and configure the receiver there

contracts.name: CCIPMessenger
contracts.description: Sends and receives authenticated text over CCIP

steps.title: Deploy the messenger on the C-Chain
Deploy the messenger on the destination chain
C-Chain side may send to the destination chain
Destination may reply to the C-Chain
C-Chain accepts replies from the destination messenger
Transfer the C-Chain messenger to its owner
Transfer the destination messenger to its owner
Encode extraArgs with the receiver's gas limit
Quote the CCIP fee in native AVAX

checks.description: The destination accepts the C-Chain messenger

review: The receiver checks the (sourceChainSelector, sender) allowlist in _ccipReceive and in getCCVsAndFinalityConfig.
ccipReceive is only callable by the router, enforced by CCIPReceiver's onlyRouter.
extraArgs carries a gas limit that covers _ccipReceive for the longest allowed message.
The allowed finality stays at bytes4(0), full finality only, unless the builder explicitly accepts faster-than-finality risk.
The destination deployment and its configuration are signed by the builder's wallet, because the destination is a user-signed network.

frontend.summary: Send a message from Avalanche to another chain and watch it arrive, with a feed of what each side has received.
audience: People sending a message or instruction to an app on another chain
Readers following the destination chain's feed
journeys: Write and send: a message box, the destination named in words, and the fee in AVAX before signing ('Send to Ethereum Sepolia for 0.02 AVAX').
Follow it: one status line through Sent, In transit and Delivered, with the expected wait for that lane and a link to track it on the CCIP explorer.
Read the feed: the newest messages received on the destination, with sender and time, readable without a wallet.
Reply: the same message box on the destination, sending back to Avalanche.
flows: Encode extraArgs with @chainlink/ccip-sdk using the receiver gas limit, quote getFee, then sendMessage with the fee as value.
Show the messageId from MessageSent with a link to https://ccip.chain.link, and poll receivedCount or MessageReceived on the destination.
Switch the wallet to the destination chain for the owner's setup transactions there.
Reply from the destination the same way, with the C-Chain selector and messenger address.
